title: Chapter 76 A Chance Encounter With Chef Zhang
content:
Chapter 76 A Chance Encounter With Chef Zhang

Wang Shuo was a little disappointed, but he also understood the other party's wise and self-protective measures.

"Although I can't do your business, you still have a choice. There is a system store in the market center, but the prices there will be higher than mine." Li Youcai said softly.

"Thank you!" Wang Shuo clasped his hands and walked out of the store.

Standing on the street, Wang Shuo felt quite depressed.

This Ni Wu is really arrogant and bullying!

"Iron Sword Gate!" Wang Shuo snorted coldly, clenching his fists with both hands and making a creaking sound.

After walking a few steps forward, Wang Shuo found a restaurant in front of him.

Fuyue Restaurant.

I happened to be a little hungry.

"Let's go in and have something to eat."

The decoration of the restaurant is not very luxurious, but the area is not small. There are ten tables in the lobby downstairs.

At this time, a boy came up and greeted Wang Shuo and others warmly.

"Sir, please come inside." The young man said with quick movements and a smile.

"Are there any seats upstairs?" Wang Shuo was a little unhappy when he saw the noisy hall.

"Sorry, sir, there are only two private rooms upstairs, and they are already full!" The waiter looked embarrassed and said with a smile.

He handled it carefully, for fear of upsetting the guests.

This group of people were armed with strong weapons and exuded a faint smell of blood. At first glance, they looked like people who were decisive in killing.

When I opened a restaurant in Nanshan City, I received players who were licking blood from their knives, and all of them were very angry.

After Wang Shuo heard this, he thought again that he might be able to hear some relevant news about Nanshan Ji in the hall.

So he said calmly: "Then let's go to the lobby!"

Everyone found a big table. After sitting down, they ordered some wine and food, and the dishes were quickly served.

At this time, the bowl with food caught his attention.

Wang Shuo took a closer look, with a look of surprise on his face.

I saw that the container for serving food actually had its own mark.

Wang Shuo felt very happy as if he had found a long-lost relative.

"Call your boss over!" Wang Shuo said to the boy.

Hearing this, the boy had a look of panic on his face.

"I don't know what made the guest unhappy. I'm here to apologize to you. I'll change it right away." The boy apologized quickly.

"It's none of your business. Is your boss's surname Zhang?"

"Exactly."

"Go and tell him that an old friend is visiting."

The boy breathed a sigh of relief and hurriedly walked towards the back hall.

In the kitchen, Chef Zhang is instructing several apprentices in cooking.

After hearing the boy's report, a look of confusion appeared on his face. How could there be an old friend in this place?

Suspicious, he took off his apron and walked out.

When he came to Wang Shuo's table, he was stunned for a moment, his mind was spinning rapidly, and he didn't remember who this person was.

"I wonder who you are?" he asked tentatively, hoping that the other party could tell himself his family name.

"Are you Chef Zhang?" Wang Shuo said with some surprise.

"Your Excellency, how do you know my name?"

Wang Shuo laughed, stood up, took a bowl in his hand, pointed at it and said, "I made this."

Chef Zhang suddenly realized: "It turns out to be Brother Wang."

He glanced at the big table again, and saw that the aggressive people were all headed by Wang Shuo, and he was horrified.

"Brother Wang, you are doing well!"

Gong Zheng, who was sitting next to Wang Shuo, immediately stood up and gave up his seat. Chef Zhang sat down and the two started chatting cordially.

Both of them were filled with joy to meet acquaintances in this place.

They told each other about their experiences during this period.

The two entered this world and had a good personal relationship since they met.

Now that we meet again, we feel a sense of mutual sympathy.

Just as the two were reminiscing about old times, another wave of people walked in.
